title: Oatmeal Cranberry Chocolate Christmas Cookies
description: The changes from the Quaker Oats lid are to replace raisins with dried cranberries, then add 2/3 cup white chocolate chips.
ingredients: 3 cups Quaker Oats, quick or old-fashioned, uncooked
directions: Beat butter and sugars until creamy. Add eggs and vanilla, beat well.
Combine flour, baking soda, cinnamon, salt; add to wet ingredients. Add oats and raisins.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake 8-10 min until light golden brown. Cool 1 min, remove to wire rack.
